stations.title: Idris
stations.say: Same lines, a different order. Why?
stations.note: Since counts are kept in memory.

stations.title: Invite count
stations.text: Already kept, so its callback runs at once.

stations.title: Idris's screen
stations.text: Every count in the same order, every night.

captions: Idris keeps the paper count in memory now, and the price list prints in a new order.
A docket already kept runs its callback at once, so the invite line jumps ahead.
You make callbacks always run later, then write all and race, in three tasks.
Now the invite count prints in its place, like the card count before it.
One order every night, many answers at once, and await is no longer a mystery.
